recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It is a narrow source-backed correction for active build-scope resources and does not alter unrelated local nested useContext elements that have different meanings.
issue_request: FHIR-17685 was Published/Persuasive and requested adding the usage-context-type code 'program', allowing UsageContext.value[x] to reference PlanDefinition, ResearchStudy, InsurancePlan, HealthcareService, Group, Location, and Organization, changing Questionnaire.useContext to clarify general categories versus specific programs, and applying that definition across conformance resources and UsageContext.
initial_application: Commit 46401227c3 ('GF#17685 - extend definition of use context') applied the core change to source/datatypes/usagecontext.xml and the historical metadata resource spreadsheet. Current source still contains the expanded UsageContext.value[x] reference list, the program code, and the clarified CanonicalResource/useContext wording in most derived resources.
additional_context: The linked Zulip thread shows the original ambiguity around whether useContext represented keyword-like categories or references to particular studies/programs. Later FHIR-38841 retained the clarified useContext wording while moving topic/jurisdiction guidance toward UsageContext. A current sweep found SpecimenDefinition and SubscriptionTopic still had the older 'These terms' wording; SubscriptionTopic also referred to code system definitions.
reconciliation: Updated SpecimenDefinition.useContext and SubscriptionTopic.useContext to include the FHIR-17685 clarified categories/programs wording and removed the obsolete SubscriptionTopic definition mapping exception that no longer represents a divergence.
source_changes: source/specimendefinition/structuredefinition-SpecimenDefinition.xml: updated SpecimenDefinition.useContext definition to include general categories and references to specific programs.

source/subscriptiontopic/structuredefinition-SubscriptionTopic.xml: updated SubscriptionTopic.useContext definition to include the clarified wording and corrected the stale 'code system definitions' ending.

source/subscriptiontopic/subscriptiontopic-definition-mapping-exceptions.xml: removed the obsolete definitionUnmatched block for SubscriptionTopic.useContext now that the resource definition matches the pattern text.

related_jiras.note: Later Published/Persuasive with Modification issue that deprecated Metadata.topic and moved topic/jurisdiction guidance toward UsageContext while retaining the FHIR-17685 clarified useContext wording.
